## Activity

During January 2024, West Gate Eye Clinic completed 427 captures. Activity proceeded as planned, with the clinic team maintaining the expected operational arrangements throughout the reporting period. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. No additional operational issues are recorded in the available report information.

## Image quality

Image quality review identified 28 ungradable sets from the completed captures. The ungradable rate was 6.6. This result provides a clear measure of the images that could not be used for grading and should continue to be monitored through routine quality assurance activity. The available information does not identify any further image-quality concern.

## Grading

A total of 114 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 5. This records the central grading turnaround for the reporting period and provides the relevant measure for ongoing review of service performance. Together, the grading activity and image-quality findings summarise the work completed at West Gate Eye Clinic during January 2024.
